description: EE2: Neutralizing Gas ends Illusion. p2's Zoroark leads with Garchomp after it (illusion set). The turn: Snorlax switches out for Weezing-Galar, whose Neutralizing Gas `onSwitchIn` runs Illusion's `End` on Zoroark; Zoroark's Nasty Plot and Garchomp's Swords Dance, then Ditto (Limber) transforms into Zoroark (+2 SpA; its copied Illusion is suppressed like every other ability).
